title: test(cli): drive os migrate list-preferences in the --json stdout-purity family
body:
Fixes #36639
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改了 CLI 的夜间测试清单，命令本身的行为没有变化。
- 为什么做：夜间测试「命令输出 JSON 时标准输出必须是纯 JSON」变红了，因为新加的偏好清理迁移命令没被列进受测名单。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是夜间测试继续报红，不影响任何发布内容；可直接撤回本次合并。
- 无。

## What changes

`packages/cli/test/json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` discovers its family from the source tree (every command that boots `bootSchemaStack`, directly or through a booting `src/utils` module, and declares a `json: Flags.boolean(` flag) and reconciles it against its `FAMILY` map. `os migrate list-preferences` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/list-preferences.ts`) boots `bootSchemaStack` with `jsonOutput: json` and declares `--json`, so it joined the discovered set without being listed, and the reconciliation went red on the nightly tier (the only tier that collects this file).

The fix lists the member and DRIVES it — the discovery and the test are untouched (the card's ruling: never rename, skip or delete the failing test). The bare form is driven: a read-only dry run (`deferSchemaDdl` + `readOnlyProbe`) whose empty report is emitted compact before the `finally` shutdown, so the shutdown's diagnostics follow the document and must stay off stdout. The command itself already keeps stdout pure: all three per-member assertions pass on the new member, so no `src/` change is owed.

Mechanism hypothesis from the dispatch: confirmed. Measured on `origin/main` 3cf6a44be by replaying the test's own discovery: discovered minus listed = exactly `migrate list-preferences`; listed minus discovered = nothing. (The nightly log at 9e2a4acb read 36 vs 35; at 3cf6a44be the two sets are 38 vs 37 — another member was listed in between; the one-name difference is the same.)

## Tests

<details><summary>nightly tier, the failing file — 116/116 on ece0fbce</summary>

`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` (under `os-verify-lock.sh`):

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  116 passed (116)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

116 = 2 family-reconciliation tests + 38 members x 3 (one JSON document on stdout by bare `JSON.parse`; no kernel-logger record on stdout; every boot diagnostic on stderr).
</details>

<details><summary>typecheck</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc --noEmit plus check:test-typecheck): VERDICT command-exit 0; check:test-typecheck OK, debt ledger held.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No changeset: the diff is one test file; `@objectstack/cli` ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` only, so nothing published moves (`skip-changeset`).
- The `migrate stored-references` comment in `FAMILY` still says the discovery does not reach that command; on 3cf6a44be the discovery does reach it (the reconciliation is green with it listed). Stale comment only, left as is — out of this card's scope.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed; the red side is the card's own nightly log, and the replayed discovery on the base shows the same one-name difference.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/cli/test/json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts`, the new `'migrate list-preferences': []` entry and its comment.

Two-minute check: `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` — expect `Tests 116 passed (116)`, including three `os migrate list-preferences --json` cases.

49 of 50 exit 0. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3: PREREQUISITE NOT MET on this shallow clone (its positive control is pinned to a commit the clone cannot reach) — NOT MEASURED locally, checker-health only; CI runs it. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 on the first pass in the sequential sweep (that output was overwritten before it was read) and exit 0 on an immediate standalone rerun (self-test 94 cases, 124 entry points load). Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs.
</details>
